(()=>{const d=document.querySelector('.shock-svg').dataset;if(Number(d.shockPivot)>=Number(window.shockBase.shockPivot)||Number(d.shockHeartHeight)<=Number(window.shockBase.shockHeartHeight)||Math.abs(Number(d.shockPressureHeight)-Number(window.shockBase.shockPressureHeight))>1e-5)throw Error('Heart-rate effect on geometry');if(document.querySelector('[data-shock-group=weight0]').innerHTML===window.shockBody)throw Error('Actual weight unchanged');if(document.querySelector('.result-number').textContent!=='1,00'||document.querySelector('#field-heartRate').value!=='120')throw Error('Shared heart-rate effect');return 'Heart rate +30 raises left weight, shifts support left and gives SI 1.00';})()

(()=>{const d=document.querySelector('.shock-svg').dataset;if(Number(d.shockPivot)<=Number(window.shockBase.shockPivot)||Number(d.shockPressureHeight)<=Number(window.shockBase.shockPressureHeight)||Math.abs(Number(d.shockHeartHeight)-Number(window.shockBase.shockHeartHeight))>1e-5)throw Error('Pressure effect on geometry');if(document.querySelector('.result-number').textContent!=='0,60')throw Error('Shared pressure effect');return 'Pressure +30 raises right weight, shifts support right and gives SI 0.60';})()

(()=>{const d=document.querySelector('.shock-svg').dataset;if(Math.abs(Number(d.shockPivot)-Number(window.shockBase.shockPivot))>1e-5)throw Error('Scaling moved support');if(Number(d.shockHeartHeight)<=Number(window.shockBase.shockHeartHeight))throw Error('Scaled model weights not updated');if(document.querySelector('#field-heartRate').value!=='180'||document.querySelector('#field-systolic').value!=='240')throw Error('Scaled values diverged');return 'Both inputs doubled: support and quotient stay fixed';})()

(()=>{if(Number(document.querySelector('#field-heartRate').value.replace(',','.'))<=90)throw Error('Direct heartRate drag failed');if(document.querySelector('#field-heartRate').value!==document.querySelector('#anatomy-heartRate').value)throw Error('Dragged inputs diverged');return 'Direct heartRate drag updates shared input';})()

(()=>{if(Number(document.querySelector('#field-systolic').value.replace(',','.'))<=120)throw Error('Direct systolic drag failed');if(document.querySelector('#field-systolic').value!==document.querySelector('#anatomy-systolic').value)throw Error('Dragged inputs diverged');return 'Direct systolic drag updates shared input';})()

(()=>{if(document.querySelector('.result-number').textContent!=='—'||document.querySelector('[data-shock-group=pivot]').style.display!=='none')throw Error('Stale invalid division');return 'Invalid pressure clears both results and moving mechanism';})()
(()=>{if(document.documentElement.scrollWidth>innerWidth)throw Error('Horizontal overflow');return 'Reset, example and viewport width pass';})()

(()=>{if(document.querySelector('.shock-svg').getBoundingClientRect().bottom>=-60)return 'Figure partly visible in this viewport; phone run checks offscreen pause';if(Number(document.querySelector('.shock-svg').dataset.shockResult)!==.75)throw Error('Offscreen animation continued');if(document.querySelector('.result-number').textContent!=='0,83')throw Error('Calculation stopped offscreen');return 'Calculation remains live while offscreen figure pauses';})()
